summary: This broad set of DOM changes improves navigation and loading behavior, including speculation rules that prefetch links on pointerdown or hover, more careful handling of speculative loads, and clearer support for Permissions Policy, the standard that controls which browser features embedded content may use. It also advances Web Speech, WebCrypto with ML-KEM support, CSS perspective and skew transforms, PDF fallbacks, scrolling and fullscreen behavior, and clipboard provenance. Many accompanying changes harden process, editing, selection, range, animation, observer, and document-lifecycle handling, so pages are less likely to hit edge-case failures while existing web features behave more consistently.
